description: This script generates the Interrupt Descriptor Table (IDT) for x86 CPUs within the Zephyr RTOS project. It reads symbol and section data from an ELF kernel image, processes interrupt routing configurations, and outputs binary tables for IDT entries, vector mappings, and free vector indicators.

methods.name: create_irq_gate
methods.description: Creates a binary representation of a 32-bit interrupt gate descriptor with specified handler address and DPL.

methods.name: create_task_gate
methods.description: Creates a binary representation of a 32-bit task gate descriptor with specified TSS and DPL.

methods.name: create_idt_binary
methods.description: Writes the IDT entries to a binary file based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: create_irq_vec_map_binary
methods.description: Outputs a binary bitfield indicating which IDT vectors are free for dynamic use.

methods.name: priority_range
methods.description: Returns a range of vectors corresponding to a given priority level.

methods.name: update_irq_vec_map
methods.description: Assigns a vector to an IRQ line in the mapping, with error checking.

methods.name: setup_idt
methods.description: Configures IDT vectors and IRQ mappings based on interrupt list and priorities.

methods.name: get_symbols
methods.description: Extracts symbol addresses from an ELF file's symbol table.

methods.name: get_intlist
methods.description: Retrieves interrupt routing configuration and spurious handlers from ELF section 'intList'.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for input/output files and options.

methods.name: create_irq_vectors_allocated
methods.description: Creates a bitfield binary indicating free IDT vectors based on handlers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates ELF parsing, IDT setup, and output generation.
